before:
jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@old # v6.5.0
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: pnpm e2e:install
after:
jobs:
  quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@new # v7.1.0
      - name: Run anti-slop lint
        run: pnpm lint:anti-slop
  visual:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: pnpm visual
